image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of two feet wearing colorful, hand-knitted wool socks resting on white bed linens. The socks feature a variegated yarn with orange, pink, yellow, and blue hues in a textured knit pattern (likely garter or seed stitch). The left foot is fully visible from the ankle down, showing the heel and instep. The right foot is partially cropped at the top right. The background consists of rumpled white sheets and a pillow.
